products.short_description: Operate Microsoft Purview eDiscovery — Content Search, Standard cases + holds, and Premium custodians/review sets/analytics/export — a defensible, repeatable workflow across Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive and Teams. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Run Microsoft 365 eDiscovery end to end — search, hold, review, export

Legal and investigation requests demand defensible eDiscovery across Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Teams — and ad-hoc content searches don't hold up. This solution operates Microsoft Purview eDiscovery: Content Search and keyword/condition query design, eDiscovery (Standard) cases and holds, and eDiscovery (Premium) custodians, review sets, analytics/de-duplication, and export — with a defensible, repeatable workflow. (Scoped to eDiscovery/search/hold/export — distinct from Purview DLP, sensitivity labels, and retention.)

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the eDiscovery model: Content Search vs Standard vs Premium, cases, holds/custodians, review sets, analytics, and export — and how it differs from Purview DLP/labels/retention.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (licensing for Standard/Premium, eDiscovery Manager/Admin roles, in-scope workloads, legal stakeholders).
  • Implementation Guide — design searches (KQL, conditions), create cases + holds/custodians, build and review a review set, run analytics/de-dup, and export defensibly — pilot-first, each case/search named; determinations deferred to legal.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic Security & Compliance / Graph PowerShell / Microsoft Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
  • Validation gates (search scoped, holds effective, export complete + defensible) plus Best Practices; legal/records determinations deferred to legal.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

eDiscovery run defensibly and repeatably — searches scoped, holds effective, review sets analyzed, exports complete — across all M365 workloads, ready for legal.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • MSEDISC-CaseHold.ps1 — create the case and a named case hold (dry-run by default)
    • MSEDISC-Discovery.ps1 — read-only eDiscovery posture, readiness, and role check
    • MSEDISC-Report.ps1 — search / hold / export status report (read-only evidence pack)
    • MSEDISC-Scope.ps1 — eDiscovery scope/config helper: compliance boundary + named-object check (dry-run by default)
    • MSEDISC-Search.ps1 — build and run a scoped Content Search (dry-run by default)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
